edit.description: the refusal after the write says the rewrite stands on disk
the wrapper carries that fact to the operator
the refusal's message names the path

summary: A ledger-commit refusal reports that the rewritten queue stands on disk uncommitted, naming the path, instead of leaving an operator to attribute a modified queue

per.section: A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered

acceptance: A commit refusal reached after the queue write says the rewrite is on disk and uncommitted at that path; a refusal reached before the write (the live foreign claim) says nothing of the kind.
tests: a ledger-commit refusal names the queue path whose rewrite stands on disk uncommitted
a tip-claim refusal reports no uncommitted rewrite, having refused before the write
notes: commitPendingUpdate writes, then commits; only the commit refuses (a paused merge, a lost index.lock). The tip check is already ordered before the write and must stay that way — the second line pins it.
